comment: Normative ids that no test names, as of 2026-09-05 (wi-418, wi-490).
This list only shrinks. An entry that grows a test has to be removed, and the check says so.
An id declared from now on is not admitted here: write the test and name the id.
Every entry states why it has no test yet, so the ones added later stay tellable from these.
Whether an id declares a refusal is derived when the debt is reported, never stored here.
